sources.citation: Avram, Andrei A. 2020. Arabic pidgins and creoles. In Christopher Lucas & Stefano Manfredi (eds.), Arabic and contact-induced change, 321-347. Berlin: Language Science Press (open access, CC BY).
sources.note: §3.3.1 Phonology (pp.327-328) treats only segmental contact effects; p.327 fn.4 names the early records of the pidgin ('Cook (1905), Jenkins (1909), Meldon (1913), and Owen & Keane (1915)') and quotes early Ugandan Kinubi forms from Avram 2017a. No statement about stress or accent in the early pidgin anywhere in the chapter.
